Recommendations show expected impact range, horizon, method, risk, alternatives, preconditions, reversibility, and why no action may be preferable.
Next steps are none, evidence, saved view, report draft, or allowlisted action preview; none execute from the insight response.
Acceptance, rejection, override, rework, verified effect, calibration, and user feedback are recorded without treating acceptance alone as correctness.
cards.title: [SKCP-31A][L] Add best-practice recommendations impact options and outcome learning

acceptance_criteria: Every response validates against the insight schema and identifies scope, window, metric versions, evidence, calculations, uncertainty, contradictions, exclusions, model provenance, and policy reference.
Numeric claims resolve to deterministic metric results and calculation traces.
Cross-scope, protected, stale, partial, unavailable, conflicting, prompt-injected, and unsupported questions have evaluation fixtures.
The system abstains when evidence, policy, source rights, classification, model qualification, or metric quality is insufficient.
The reporting model has no command tool, capability token, arbitrary network, shell, filesystem, email, filing, calendar, or connector access.
cards.title: [SKCP-31][L] Build governed read-only AI insight query and evaluation suite

acceptance_criteria: Economy navigation clearly separates AI Usage, Autopilot Cost, and Joule without treating tokens, USD, or Joules as equivalent.
A read-only API projects valid append-only skcounter.snapshot.v1 observations from an isolated configurable data root and degrades cleanly on missing or malformed data.
Harness-reported and gateway-observed lanes remain separately filterable and are not summed by default.
The AI Usage UI exposes totals, trends, token dimensions, cache ratio, time metrics, model/client/provider/node breakdowns, collector coverage, freshness, backend versions, and cost estimation state.
No raw prompt, response, workspace path, source path, credential, or raw session identifier is read or rendered.
Tests cover empty, seeded, malformed, stale, lane-separated, and page registration behavior, and existing Economy tests remain green or retain their documented dependency skip.
Architecture and operator documentation define the SKCounter, SKDashboard, SKJoule, SKGateway, and central collector boundaries.
cards.title: [SKDASHBOARD][M] Add SKCounter AI Usage to the Economy workspace

acceptance_criteria: complete_task refuses any task with an unknown or non-done folded dependency and reports every blocking ID.
The completion check applies to claimed, doing, and review cards and cannot be bypassed by stale legacy birth dependencies.
d0edbff1 has one effective append-only dependency on bea13a70, while bea13a70 remains incomplete.
All original and new implementation cards retain a direct or transitive path through d0edbff1 to bea13a70.
Focused and full SKCoord, relevant SKCapstone CLI, installed read-only topology, Ruff, parity, lifecycle, and rollback tests pass.
No human gate, independent review, implementation card, deployment, external action, commit, or push is completed.
cards.title: [SKCP-00F3F][M] Enforce completion dependencies and bind superseding human gate

acceptance_criteria: All twelve silo evidence keys resolve to silo-correct content with no unrelated fallback.
Changing scope, time window, or baseline updates all relevant evidence and specialist deep links while retaining role context.
Synthetic ready, stale-target, denied-policy, expired, and changed-parameter states visibly update preview status and authorization availability.
Focused interaction tests cover all evidence keys, dynamic scope links, disabled-state reasons, keyboard behavior, and original artifact preservation.
V2 screenshots and remediation evidence are refreshed without modifying any original manifest-pinned artifact.
cards.title: [SKCP-00F2A][M] Correct V2 evidence routing and authorization state transitions
